# Pointly

> Pointly is a free, real-time planning poker app for agile teams. Create a room, share the code, vote on story points together. No signup, no install, no DB — in-memory only.

## About

This file provides a structured overview of the documentation and content available on this site,
optimized for consumption by Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI assistants.

## Pages

- [Pointly — Free Real-Time Planning Poker for Agile Teams](https://pointly.space)
  Pointly is a free, real-time planning poker app for agile teams. Create a room in 100ms, share a 6-character code, vote on story points together, and reveal in one click. No signup, no install, in-memory only.
- [Join a room](https://pointly.space/join)
  Enter a room code to join an existing planning poker session.
- [Arena](https://pointly.space/arena)
  Live planning poker arena where the host runs rounds and the team votes on story points.
- [Room full](https://pointly.space/full)
  The room reached its seat limit.
